ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (dark gray/black) to 25% high-intensity (white/light gray) distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity geometric blobs located in the inner-medial regions of both lobes, radiating from the peduncle attachment point. High-frequency, low-diameter white pixel speckling is scattered across the dark peripheral regions of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks (coarse serration) at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity on leading edges with a shallow concave curvature on the trailing edges prior to the distal serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A distinct constellation of four circular dark-ringed pixel clusters on the upper-right lobe; a single, similar circular anomaly is localized on the far-left lobe near the tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three discrete, vertically oriented high-intensity linear streaks located within the white pigmentation patch of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily irregular and jagged distal tips on both lobes indicating potential tissue loss or repetitive environmental impact; multiple circular scars consistent with parasitic or barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of high-contrast white micro-dots scattered across the dark central and lower regions of the fluke blades.
